intent: The recorded collaborations and the compiled guard say the same thing, so neither can quietly widen the other.
actor: A developer relying on the Registry to know what a Context may call
observable_outcome: For every ordered pair of Bounded Contexts, exactly one of two things holds: the guard denies it, or the Registry permits it.

acceptance_criteria.statement: No pair is both denied by the compiled guard and permitted by the Registry, and none is neither.
A collaboration the guard forbids is recorded as a forbidden policy carrying why, not left absent.
